title: Innokin Kwik 35K Menthol Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Menthol provides a clean, cooling flavour with a bright, crisp finish. This classic blend delivers refreshing satisfaction that stays steady across each puff. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container built for the Innokin Kwik 35K device. The mesh-coil pod ensures pure flavour, while the dual-chamber auto-feed system prevents dry hits for consistent vapour. Discover all our flavours: Explore full flavours of Innokin Kwik 35k Pods How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 35K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
